verdict.rationale: The IRS does run machine channels, MeF XML e-file and the IRIS A2A intake, so the question of versioned APIs applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents API versioning or a deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Evidence of a credentialed machine channel is adjacent and does not show versioning or deprecation commitments.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
